question_text: A nucleus is at rest in the laboratory frame of reference. Show that if it disintegrates into two smaller nuclei the products must move in opposite directions.
answer_text: Let m1, m2, and m be the respective masses of the parent nucleus and the two daughter nuclei. The parent nucleus is at rest. Initial momentum of the system (parent nucleus) = 0. Let v1 and v2 be the respective velocities of the daughter nuclei having masses m1 and m2. Total linear momentum of the system after disintegration = m1v1 + m2v2. According to the law of conservation of momentum: Total initial momentum = Total final momentum. Here, the negative sign indicates that the fragments of the parent nucleus move in directions opposite to each other.
final_answer: Thus, the products must move in opposite directions.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of conservation of momentum and basic application.

question_text: Explain why: a horse cannot pull a cart and run in empty space, passengers are thrown forward from their seats when a speeding bus stops suddenly, it is easier to pull a lawn mower than to push it, a cricketer moves his hands backwards while holding a catch.

parts.part_text: a horse cannot pull a cart and run in empty space
parts.answer_text: In order to pull a cart, a horse pushes the ground backward with some force. The ground in turn exerts an equal and opposite reaction force upon the feet of the horse. An empty space is devoid of any such reaction force. Therefore, a horse cannot pull a cart and run in empty space.
parts.final_answer: Thus, a horse cannot pull a cart in empty space due to the lack of reaction force.

parts.part_text: passengers are thrown forward from their seats when a speeding bus stops suddenly
parts.answer_text: When a speeding bus stops suddenly, the lower portion of a passenger’s body, which is in contact with the seat, suddenly comes to rest. However, the upper portion tends to remain in motion (as per the first law of motion). As a result, the passenger’s upper body is thrown forward in the direction in which the bus was moving.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, passengers are thrown forward due to inertia.

parts.part_text: it is easier to pull a lawn mower than to push it
parts.answer_text: While pulling a lawn mower, a force at an angle θ is applied on it, which has a vertical component that acts upward, reducing the effective weight of the mower. In contrast, while pushing, the vertical component of the applied force acts downward, increasing the effective weight. Hence, pulling is easier.
parts.final_answer: Thus, pulling a lawn mower is easier than pushing it due to the effective weight difference.

parts.part_text: a cricketer moves his hands backwards while holding a catch
parts.answer_text: While taking a catch, a cricketer moves his hand backward to increase the time of impact (Δt). This results in a decrease in the stopping force, thereby preventing the hands of the cricketer from getting hurt.
parts.final_answer: Therefore, moving hands backward reduces the impact force.

difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of multiple concepts of motion and forces.
